'''Dwi'lar''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]], the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Kothlis system/Legends|Kothlis system]].

Along with the other gas giant of the system, [[Dwi'kar]], the two were known as "siblings" or "the twins" by the locals of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] that orbited between them. Dwi'kar was the cooler of the two and its surface consisted of green and blue gases.<ref name="guide" />

[[Botha Ammunitions Corporation]] harvested [[blaster/Legends|blaster]] gases from the two planets.<ref name="guide" />
